moderntech.configuration.almostUnifiedIn: Enable the Almost Unified integration, if present.
moderntech.configuration.armorHudYPositi: Space between the top of the screen and the jetpack/GraviChestPlate overlay text.
moderntech.configuration.barrelContentRe: Enable rendering of barrel content: item icon, item amount, and item name.
moderntech.configuration.compostableToPl: Generate plant oil recipes in the centrifuge for all compostable items.
moderntech.configuration.datagenOnStartu: Run MI runtime datagen on startup.
moderntech.configuration.debugCommands.t: Enable UNSUPPORTED and DANGEROUS debug commands.
moderntech.configuration.defaultIndustri: Enable the default trades from the Industrialist villager provided by MI. Disable this to provide your own set of trades.
moderntech.configuration.defaultOreGenTo: Enable the default ore generation tooltips. These tooltips show how each MI ore generates, based on the default ore generation settings in MI. Set this to false if you change the ore features in a datapack.
moderntech.configuration.ftbQuestsIntegr: Enable machine production and built multiblock progress for FTB Quests, if present.
moderntech.configuration.hatchPlacementO: Show valid hatch positions in multiblocks when holding a hatch.
moderntech.configuration.interMachineCon: Enable connected textures between machines that have the same casing. (Requires a suitable resource pack)
moderntech.configuration.itemTagTooltips: Add item tags to item tooltips.
moderntech.configuration.machineSoundVol: Volume of the machine working sounds.
moderntech.configuration.machineSounds.t: Play a working sound while a machine is running.
moderntech.configuration.maxDistillation: Maximum height of the distillation tower multiblock.
moderntech.configuration.maxMultiblockHi: Show valid positions in multiblocks when holding a hatch or wrench while within this many blocks. Set to 0 to disable.
moderntech.configuration.missingRecipeVi: Enable login message when EMI, JEI and REI are all missing.
moderntech.configuration.multiblockToolt: Show block information when looking at the hologram display of a multiblock.
moderntech.configuration.respawnWithGuid: Grant guidebook when a player respawns after death.
moderntech.configuration.spawnWithGuideB: Grant guidebook the first time a player joins the server.
moderntech.configuration.steamPerWater.t: How much steam should be produced per mb of water that is boiled.
moderntech.configuration.stonecutterToCu: Generate cutting machine recipes for all stonecutter recipes.
moderntech.configuration.transactionCall: Enable to have transfer transactions include the name of the class that called it. Note that this comes at the cost of performance. It is recommended to not use this outside of debugging.
moderntech.configuration.validateRecipeL: On datapack load, check every machine recipe against the levels the machines of its type can reach, and log the ones nothing can craft. This only ever logs a warning, it never changes or removes a recipe. Turn it off if the checks get in the way.

text.moderntech.NoEmi: WARNING: To play with ModernTech, we STRONGLY RECOMMEND using EMI (Item and Recipe Viewer). Otherwise you won't be able to view the recipes in-game, and you will not be able to deal with conflicting machine recipes. Just Enough Items and Roughly Enough Items are also supported. This message can be disabled in the config.

text.moderntech.ShapeSelectionDescriptio: Drag the slider to resize the multiblock.
